summary: GeneralPurposeEstimate::new rounds lengths upward using checked additions that overflow near usize::MAX. The chunk-count calculation panics first for encoded_len > usize::MAX - 7. The fix divides before adding a remainder indicator, preserving both rounded estimates without overflow. The regression test added by this commit checks both estimates against u128 calculations, including inputs near usize::MAX. This plan reverses only the constructor implementation; no tests were run.
expected_failure: Overflow when calculating number of chunks in input
